info.name: Fire Recovery USA Getting Started Guide
info.description:
Welcome to the Fire Recovery API Getting Started Guide. This guide will help you quickly access our API methods which enable you to manage your incidents and inspections for billing. The API provides endpionts for: Authentication, Managing Incidents and Inspections billing.

Key Features:

  • Authenticate and get Tokens.

  • Submit Incidents, include attachments. Request billing status in upcoming release.

  • Submit Inspections, include attachments. Request billing status in upcoming release.

Support - We're here to help.

  • Please submit your support request to: support@firerecoveryusa.com. An API support tech will be happy to assist you.

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Login and Get JWT Token

This endpoint is used to authenticate and obtain a JWT token for accessing the system. A valid JWT Token is required in the header of each method call. The request should be sent as an HTTP POST to the specified URL.

Request Body

  • userName (string) - The username of the account.

  • password (string) - The password of the account.

  • outputtype (string) - The type of output expected, in this case, it is "Json".

Response

Upon a successful request, the server will respond with a status code of 200 and a content type of "text/Json". The response body will contain the JWT token under the key "LoginAndGetJWTTokenResult".

Example Sucess Response:

{"LoginAndGetJWTTokenResult":"<JWT Token>"}

Potential Errors:

Error Response: 401 Unauthorized

Description:

This is a result of an incorrect username or password. Please review the credentials in your Welcome Email to ensure you have the correct values.

Error Response: 500 Internal Server Error

Description:

Something internally has errored during the processing of your request. Please try again and if the issue persist, please contact our support.

item.description: Bearer Token Authentication is used for authentication when accessing methods. To generate a token, the developer will access Generate JWT Token method using Basic Auth providing username \ password. Developer credentials are sent in the Welcome Message when provided access. Tokens expire in 7 days. It is recommended to generate a token prior to each method call to ensure the token is not expired.

request.description:
Add Inspection Attachment For Billing

This endpoint allows you to add an attachment for billing related to a specific inspection.

Authentication

Before making a request to this endpoint, you must authenticate and obtain an token. This token should be included as a Bearer token in the header of your request.

Potential Errors

404 Not Found

This error indicates the tracking Id could not be located for the inspection.

Status Code: 404 Not Found
Response Body:
{
    "Done": 
    {
        "code": "404",
        "error": "The provided Inspection tracking ID is invalid."
    }
}

Request Body

  • outputtype (string): Specifies the type of output, in this case, it is set to "Json".

  • InspectionTrackingId (string): The unique identifier for the inspection to which the attachment will be added.

  • Attachments (array): Contains the details of the attachment to be added, including:

    • Id (string): The identifier for the attachment.

    • FileName (string): The name of the file.

    • Contents (string): The base64-encoded content of the file.

Response

The response will contain the status of the operation, along with any relevant details or error messages.

request.description:
Get Billing Status for Inspection

This endpoint retrieves the billing status associated with a specific inspection. It is used to obtain information regarding payments, invoices, and overall billing status based on the provided inspection tracking ID.

Request Body

The request body should be in JSON format and must include the following parameters:

  • outputtype (string): Specifies the desired format of the output. For this endpoint, it should be set to "Json".

  • InspectionBillingStatus (object): Contains details related to the inspection billing status.

    • InspectionTrackingID (string): The unique identifier for the inspection whose billing status is being requested. This is a required field.

Example Request Body:

{
  "outputtype": "Json",
  "InspectionBillingStatus": {
    "InspectionTrackingID": "270699d3-5dc0-44d1-99ff-b2beca..."
  }
}

Response

The response will be returned in JSON format and includes the following structure:

  • Done (object): Indicates the completion of the request.

    • InspectionBillingStatusResponse (object): Contains the details of the billing status.

      • LastPaymentDate (string or null): The date of the last payment made.

      • InvoiceAmountDue (string): The amount currently due for the invoice.

      • DaysOverDue (integer): The number of days the invoice is overdue.

      • InvoiceStatus (string): The current status of the invoice.

      • InvoiceID (string): The unique identifier for the invoice.

      • InvoiceSubmitDate (string): The date when the invoice was submitted.

      • InvoiceAmount (string): The total amount of the invoice.

      • InspectionTrackingID (string): The tracking ID associated with the inspection.

      • LastPaymentAmount (number or null): The amount of the last payment made.

Example Response:

{
  "Done": {
    "InspectionBillingStatusResponse": {
      "LastPaymentDate": null,
      "InvoiceAmountDue": "",
      "DaysOverDue": 0,
      "InvoiceStatus": "",
      "InvoiceID": "",
      "InvoiceSubmitDate": "",
      "InvoiceAmount": "",
      "InspectionTrackingID": "",
      "LastPaymentAmount": null
    }
  }
}

This endpoint is essential for tracking the financial aspects of inspections, providing users with up-to-date billing information.

Get Billing Status for Inspections

This endpoint retrieves the billing status for multiple inspections based on their tracking IDs. It allows users to check the current billing information related to inspections in bulk.

Request Body

The request body must be in JSON format and should include the following parameters:

  • outputtype (string): Specifies the format of the output. Must be set to "Json".

  • BulkInspectionBillingStatus (array): An array of objects, each containing:

    • InspectionTrackingID (string): The unique identifier for the inspection.

Example Request Body:

{
  "outputtype": "Json",
  "BulkInspectionBillingStatus": [
    {
      "InspectionTrackingID": "270699d3-5dc0-44d1-99ff-b2beca ..."
    }
  ]
}

Response

On success, the response will have a status code of 200 and will return a JSON object containing the billing status for the inspections requested.

Response Format

The response body will include:

  • Done (object): Contains the result of the billing status request.

    • BulkInspectionBillingStatusResponse (array): An array of objects with the following fields:

      • InvoiceStatus (string): The current status of the invoice.

      • InvoiceSubmitDate (string): The date the invoice was submitted.

      • InvoiceID (string): The unique identifier for the invoice.

      • DaysOverDue (integer): The number of days the invoice is overdue.

      • InvoiceAmountDue (string): The amount due for the invoice.

      • InspectionTrackingID (string): The tracking ID of the inspection.

      • InvoiceAmount (string): The total amount of the invoice.

      • LastPaymentAmount (null or string): The amount of the last payment made.

      • LastPaymentDate (null or string): The date of the last payment made.

Example Response:

{
  "Done": {
    "BulkInspectionBillingStatusResponse": [
      {
        "InvoiceStatus": "",
        "InvoiceSubmitDate": "",
        "InvoiceID": "",
        "DaysOverDue": 0,
        "InvoiceAmountDue": "",
        "InspectionTrackingID": "",
        "InvoiceAmount": "",
        "LastPaymentAmount": null,
        "LastPaymentDate": null
      }
    ]
  }
}

API Endpoint: Get Billing Status for Incident

This endpoint retrieves the billing status associated with a specific incident. It allows users to check various details related to the billing of an incident using its unique tracking ID.

Request Body

The request must include a JSON payload with the following structure:

{
  "IncidentBillingStatus": {
    "IncidentTrackingID": "<string>"
  }
}
  • IncidentTrackingID (string): The unique identifier for the incident whose billing status is being requested.

Response

Upon a successful request, the API will return a JSON response with a status code of 200. The response structure is as follows:

{
  "Done": {
    "IncidentBillingStatusResponse": {
      "IncidentTrackingID": "<string>",
      "InvoiceID": "<string>",
      "InvoiceAmount": "<number>",
      "InvoiceAmountDue": "<number>",
      "InvoiceSubmitDate": "<string>",
      "InvoiceStatus": "<string>",
      "LastPaymentDate": "<string>",
      "LastPaymentAmount": "<number>",
      "PaymentPlan": <boolean>
    }
  }
}

Response Fields

  • IncidentTrackingID (string): The tracking ID of the incident.

  • InvoiceID (string): The ID of the invoice associated with the incident.

  • InvoiceAmount (number): The total amount of the invoice.

  • InvoiceAmountDue (number): The amount that is still due on the invoice.

  • InvoiceSubmitDate (string): The date when the invoice was submitted.

  • InvoiceStatus (string): The current status of the invoice (e.g., paid, pending).

  • LastPaymentDate (string): The date of the last payment made towards the invoice.

  • LastPaymentAmount (number): The amount of the last payment.

  • PaymentPlan (boolean): Indicates whether a payment plan is in place for the invoice.

This endpoint is essential for users needing to track their billing status for incidents, providing key financial details and payment history.

request.description:
Add Inspection for Billing

This endpoint allows you to submit an inspection for billing to the Recovery Hub system. Complete the Request Body with the details of your inspection to post. On Success, this method will return a tracking Id that you can use to post additional attachments.

Purpose

This method enables departments to programmatically submit fire inspection records for billing purposes. It creates a billable inspection record in the Recovery Hub system, associating it with a specific occupancy, inspector, and person to bill. The endpoint is designed to streamline the billing workflow for fire departments and inspection agencies.

Authentication

Before making a request to this endpoint, you must authenticate and obtain a token. This token should be included as a Bearer token in the header of your request.

Authentication Header:

Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

Request Parameters

URL Parameters

  • baseURL: The base URL for the Recovery Hub API environment

Headers

  • Content-Type: application/json (required)

  • Authorization: Bearer token obtained from authentication (required)

Request Body Structure

The request body contains a nested InspectionToBillPayload object with the following key components:

Top Level

  • NERISDepartmentId (string, required): The unique identifier for the department in the NERIS system

  • DepartmentName (string, required): The name of the department submitting the inspection

Inspection Object

Contains detailed information about the inspection being billed:

Core Inspection Fields:

  • InspectionId (string, required): Unique identifier for the inspection

  • ReferenceId (string): Reference identifier for the inspection. If exists, will show on inspection invoice.

  • InspectorId (integer, required): ID of the inspector who performed the inspection

  • InspectorName (string, required): Full name of the inspector

  • TypeDescription (string, required): Description of the inspection type (e.g., "Annual Fire Inspection", "Re-inspection")

  • InspectionNumberOfSeconds (integer, required): Duration of the inspection in seconds

  • Scheduled (datetime, required): Date and time when the inspection was scheduled (ISO 8601 format)

  • Completed (datetime, required): Date and time when the inspection was completed (ISO 8601 format)

  • InspectionReportURL (string, optional): URL to the inspection report document

  • InspectionInDrafts (boolean, required): Indicates to place inspection in Drafts.

  • GenerateInspectionFee (boolean, required): Indicates to generate inspection fee.

  • InspectionFee (decimal, required): The fee amount for the inspection

  • FiscalYear (string, required): The fiscal year for billing purposes

  • Reinspection (boolean, required): Indicates if this is a reinspection

Cost Recovery Object:

  • Type (string, required): The type of cost recovery

  • ReinspectionNumber (integer, required): Number indicating which reinspection this is (0 for initial inspection)

  • RelatedInspections (array, optional): A list of related inspections associated with this cost recovery record. This field appears at InspectionToBillPayload.InspectionsToBill.inspection.CostRecovery.RelatedInspections and can be used to reference other inspections tied to the billed inspection.

    RelatedInspections Item Structure:

    • InspectionID (string, required): The identifier of a related inspection.

    • ReinspectionNumber (integer, required): The reinspection sequence number for that related inspection.

    Example:

    "RelatedInspections": [
  {
    "InspectionID": "INS-2024-001",
    "ReinspectionNumber": 0
  },
  {
    "InspectionID": "INS-2024-001-R1",
    "ReinspectionNumber": 1
  }
]

Occupancy Object:
Contains details about the property being inspected:

  • OccupancyId (string, required): Unique identifier for the occupancy

  • OccupancyName (string, required): Name of the occupancy/business

  • OccupancyAddress (string, required): Street address of the occupancy

  • OccupancyAddress2 (string, optional): Additional address information (suite, unit, etc.)

  • OccupancyCity (string, required): City where the occupancy is located

  • OccupancyState (string, required): State where the occupancy is located

  • OccupancyZip (string, required): ZIP code of the occupancy

  • Street (string, required): Street name

  • Number (string, required): Street number

  • StPrefix (string, optional): Street prefix (N, S, E, W)

  • StType (string, optional): Street type (Ave, St, Rd, etc.)

  • StSuffix (string, optional): Street suffix

  • AptRoom (string, optional): Apartment or room number

  • PropertyUse (string, required): Code for property use classification

  • PropertyUseDescription (string, required): Description of property use

  • BuildingClass (string, required): Building classification code

  • BuildingClassDescription (string, required): Description of building class

  • BuildingStatus (string, required): Current status of the building

  • BuildingStatusDescription (string, required): Description of building status

  • SQFT (integer, required): Square footage of the occupancy

  • NumberOfUnits (integer, required): Number of units in occupancy

  • NumberOfFloors (integer, required): Number of floors in the building

  • OccupantLoad (integer, required): Maximum occupant load

Person To Bill Object:
Contains information about the entity responsible for payment:

  • PersonToBillId (string, required): Unique identifier for the person/entity to bill

  • PersonToBillBusiness (string, optional): Business name if applicable

  • PersonToBillFirst (string, required): First name of the person to bill

  • PersonToBillMiddle (string, optional): Middle name or initial

  • PersonToBillLast (string, required): Last name of the person to bill

  • PersonToBillAddress (string, required): Billing address

  • PersonToBillAddress2 (string, optional): Additional billing address information

  • PersonToBillCity (string, required): Billing city

  • PersonToBillState (string, required): Billing state

  • PersonToBillZip (string, required): Billing ZIP code

  • PersonToBillEmail (string, required): Email address for billing communications

  • PersonToBillPhoneNumber (object, required): Phone contact information

    • Phone (string, required): Phone number

    • PhoneExt (string, optional): Phone extension

Violations Object:
Contains information about any violations found during inspection:

  • HasViolations (boolean, required): Indicates if violations were found

  • ViolationCount (integer, required): Total number of violations found

  • RepairedViolationCount (integer, required): Number of violations that have been repaired

Additional Items Array:
Optional array of additional billable items associated with the inspection:

  • ItemCode (string, required): Code identifying the item type

  • ItemDescription (string, required): Description of the additional item

  • ItemQuantity (integer, required): Quantity of the item

  • ItemFee (decimal, required): Fee for the item

  • ItemDate (datetime, required): Date associated with the item

  • ItemNote (string, optional): Additional notes about the item

  • Attributes Array: Optional array of name : value pairs for additional billing parameters

Response Structure

Success Response (200 OK)

{
  "Done": {
    "API Response": {
      "ErrorCode": "200",
      "Status": 1,
      "Message": "Success"
    },
    "TrackingId": "unique-tracking-identifier"
  }
}

Response Fields:

  • ErrorCode: HTTP status code as string

  • Status: Integer status (1 = success, 0 = failure)

  • Message: Human-readable status message

  • TrackingId: Unique identifier for tracking this inspection submission (used for attaching documents)

Error Responses

400 Bad Request - Invalid NERIS Department ID

Occurs when the provided NERIS Department ID is not valid or not found in the system.

{
  "Done": {
    "API Response": {
      "ErrorCode": "400",
      "Status": 0,
      "Message": "Invalid NERIS Department ID."
    },
    "TrackingId": null
  }
}

400 Bad Request - Missing Required Fields

Occurs when required fields are missing from the request body.

{
  "Done": {
    "API Response": {
      "ErrorCode": "400",
      "Status": 0,
      "Message": "Missing required field: [field name]"
    },
    "TrackingId": null
  }
}

400 Bad Request - Invalid Data Format

Occurs when data is provided in an incorrect format (e.g., invalid date format, non-numeric values in numeric fields).

{
  "Done": {
    "API Response": {
      "ErrorCode": "400",
      "Status": 0,
      "Message": "Invalid data format for field: [field name]"
    },
    "TrackingId": null
  }
}

401 Unauthorized - Invalid or Expired Token

Occurs when the authentication token is missing, invalid, or has expired.

{
  "Done": {
    "API Response": {
      "ErrorCode": "401",
      "Status": 0,
      "Message": "Unauthorized: Invalid or expired authentication token"
    },
    "TrackingId": null
  }
}

500 Internal Server Error

Occurs when there is an unexpected error on the server side.

{
  "Done": {
    "API Response": {
      "ErrorCode": "500",
      "Status": 0,
      "Message": "An internal server error occurred"
    },
    "TrackingId": null
  }
}

Usage Example

Request

Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

    "NERISDepartmentId": "DEPT123",
    "DepartmentName": "Springfield Fire Department",
    "InspectionsToBill": {

          "ReinspectionNumber": 0,
          "RelatedInspections": [
            {
              "InspectionID": "INS-2024-001",
              "ReinspectionNumber": 0
            },
            {

            }
          ],
          "Occupancy": {
            "OccupancyId": "OCC-12345",

Best Practices

  1. Authentication: Always ensure your authentication token is valid before making requests. Tokens may expire and need to be refreshed.

  2. Data Validation: Validate all required fields before submitting to avoid 400 errors. Pay special attention to:

    • Date formats (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss)

    • Numeric fields (integers and decimals)

    • Required vs. optional fields

  3. NERIS Department ID: Verify that your department ID is correctly registered in the NERIS system before attempting to submit inspections.

  4. Tracking ID: Store the returned TrackingId for future reference. This ID is essential for:

request.description:
Endpoint Description

This endpoint retrieves the billing status for multiple incidents based on their tracking IDs. It allows users to submit a bulk request and receive detailed billing information for each incident.

Request Body

The request body must be in JSON format and should include the following parameter:

  • BulkIncidentBillingStatus (Array of Objects): A collection of incident tracking IDs for which the billing status is requested.

    • IncidentTrackingID (String): The unique identifier for each incident.

Example Request Body:

{
  "BulkIncidentBillingStatus": [
    {
      "IncidentTrackingID": "daff910a-c86c-481a-9f35-b6692a..."
    }
  ]
}

Response

On successful execution, the API will return a JSON object containing the billing status for each incident. The response structure is as follows:

  • Done (Object): Contains the result of the billing status request.

    • BulkIncidentBillingStatusResponse (Array of Objects): An array of responses corresponding to each incident tracking ID provided in the request.

      • IncidentTrackingID (String): The tracking ID of the incident.

      • InvoiceID (String): The ID of the invoice associated with the incident.

      • InvoiceAmount (String): The total amount of the invoice.

      • InvoiceAmountDue (String): The amount that is currently due for payment.

      • InvoiceSubmitDate (String): The date when the invoice was submitted.

      • InvoiceStatus (String): The current status of the invoice (e.g., Paid, Unpaid).

      • LastPaymentDate (String): The date of the last payment made.

      • LastPaymentAmount (String): The amount of the last payment made.

      • PaymentPlan (Boolean): Indicates whether there is a payment plan associated with the incident.

Example Response:

{
  "Done": {
    "BulkIncidentBillingStatusResponse": [
      {
        "IncidentTrackingID": "",
        "InvoiceID": "",
        "InvoiceAmount": "",
        "InvoiceAmountDue": "",
        "InvoiceSubmitDate": "",
        "InvoiceStatus": "",
        "LastPaymentDate": "",
        "LastPaymentAmount": "",
        "PaymentPlan": true
      }
    ]
  }
}

Status Codes

  • 200 OK: The request was successful, and the billing status information is returned.

request.description:
Summary

Creates a billing incident in Recovery Hub from a NERIS incident payload. Use this endpoint to submit incident, location, occupancy, station, unit, action, and cost recovery details for billing processing.

Behavioral Notes

  • RespondingUnits should continue to be sent when unit-level response details are available.

  • Narrative should continue to be included when incident notes or descriptive context need to be passed through for billing review.

Request Body

The request body is a JSON object with the following structure:

{
  "IncidentToBillPayload": {
    "NERISDepartmentId": "string",
    "DepartmentName": "string",
    "IncidentsToBill": {
      "incident": {
        "FirstUnitOnSceneDateTime": "date-time",
        "Location": {
          "LocationID": "string",
          "Address": "string",
          "City": "string",
          "State": "string",
          "Zip": "string"
        },
        "Occupancydata": {
          "City": "string",
          "Zip": "string",
          "Occupancyid": "string",
          "OccupancyName": "string",
          "Address": "string",
          "Phone": "string",
          "State": "string",
          "Email": "string"
        },
        "RespondingUnits": [],
        "IncidentTypeDescription": "string",
        "IncidentID": "string",
        "ClearedDateTime": "date-time",
        "Narrative": "string",
        "IncidentActionsTaken": [],
        "HazmatNarrative": "string",
        "IncidentType": "string",
        "Stations": {
          "Station": "string"
        },
        "CostRecovery": {
          "CatchCreated": "string",
          "FiledBy": {
            "Last": "string",
            "First": "string",
            "Middle": "string"
          },
          "TotalPersonnelOnScene": 0,
          "Parties": [],
          "LawEnforcementNumber": "string",
          "PrincipleIncidentType": "string",
          "IncidentNumber": "string",
          "NerisIdIncident": "string"
        },
        "CanceledInRoute": false,
        "AlarmDateTime": "date-time"
      }
    }
  }
}

Field Guide

  • IncidentToBillPayload.NERISDepartmentId: NERIS department identifier.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.DepartmentName: Department name associated with the incident.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.FirstUnitOnSceneDateTime: Timestamp for the first unit arriving on scene.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.Location: Incident location details including ID, address, city, state, and ZIP.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.Occupancydata: Occupancy or property contact details.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.RespondingUnits: Collection of responding unit records.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.IncidentTypeDescription: Human-readable incident type description.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.IncidentID: Source incident identifier.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.ClearedDateTime: Timestamp when the incident was cleared.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.Narrative: Narrative text for the incident.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.IncidentActionsTaken: Collection of actions taken during the incident.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.HazmatNarrative: Hazmat-specific narrative details, when applicable.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.IncidentType: Incident type code or identifier.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.Stations.Station: Station value associated with the incident.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery: Billing and recovery metadata.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery.CatchCreated: Cost recovery creation indicator or source value.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery.FiledBy: Name of the person who filed the incident.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery.TotalPersonnelOnScene: Total personnel count on scene.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery.Parties: Collection of related parties for recovery or billing.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery.LawEnforcementNumber: Related law enforcement reference number.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery.PrincipleIncidentType: Principal incident type used for recovery processing.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery.IncidentNumber: Billing or recovery incident number.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CostRecovery.NerisIdIncident: NERIS incident identifier used in recovery context.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.CanceledInRoute: Indicates whether the response was canceled while units were en route.

  • IncidentToBillPayload.IncidentsToBill.incident.AlarmDateTime: Timestamp when the alarm was received.

Expected Response

A successful response returns a Done object containing API status details and a tracking identifier.

{
  "Done": {
    "API Response": {
      "ErrorCode": null,
      "Status": 1,
      "Message": "Success"
    },
    "TrackingId": "bf57d460-c01f-47d4-bc28-9250de2d922a"
  }
}

  • Done.API Response.Status: 1 indicates success.

  • Done.API Response.Message: Success message from the API.

  • Done.API Response.ErrorCode: null when no error is returned.

  • Done.TrackingId: Identifier that can be used for downstream tracing or support.

Notes

  • This request uses the collection or environment authentication already configured in Postman.

  • A successful submission is indicated by Status: 1 and Message: "Success" in the response.

request.description:
Retrieves payment reconciliation records for incident billing within a requested date range. This method submits a report payload to the Recovery Hub public API and returns reconciliation results paged by limit and offset.

Authorization

  • Requires a valid JWT bearer token on the request.
  • Requires a valid subscription key in the request body as ReportPayloadRequest.ReportData.SubscriptionKey.
  • Send Content-Type: application/json.

Request Body

{
  "ReportPayloadRequest": {
    "ReportData": {
      "SubscriptionKey": "{{SubscriptionKey}}",
      "StartDate": "1/24/2026",
      "EndDate": "2/24/2026",
      "Limit": 1000,
      "Offset": 0
    }
  }
}

Body Parameters

  • ReportPayloadRequest object containing the report request.
  • ReportPayloadRequest.ReportData object containing report filter and paging fields.
  • ReportPayloadRequest.ReportData.SubscriptionKey string. Subscription key issued for the requesting department or tenant.

  • ReportPayloadRequest.ReportData.EndDate string. End of the reconciliation date range to return.
  • ReportPayloadRequest.ReportData.Limit integer. Maximum number of records to return in a page.
  • ReportPayloadRequest.ReportData.Offset integer. Zero-based offset used for pagination.

request.description: Retrieves the current billing status of a previously submitted invoice using its tracking ID.

Creates a new billing invoice record for a department or business account.

Authorization

  • Bearer token required: Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

Request

  • Method: POST

  • URL: https://process.firerecoveryusa.com/Primary/restapi/rhpublicapi/flows/v1apis/invoices/addinvoiceforbilling

Required Headers

  • Content-Type: application/json

  • Authorization: Bearer {{token}}

Body
Send a JSON body with an InvoicesBilling object containing invoice and billing details.

Key fields

  • NERISDepartmentId: Department identifier.

  • DepartmentName: Name of the department.

  • DueDays: Number of days until payment is due.

  • FiscalYear: Fiscal year for the invoice.

  • RegardingAddress: Address the invoice relates to.

  • BillingEmail: Email address for billing notifications.

  • BillingAddress: Mailing or billing address.

  • BusinessName: Business or account name.

  • AttentionTo: Primary recipient or contact name.

  • LineItems: Array of invoice line items.

    • Type: Line item category.

    • Detail: Description of the billed item.

    • Quantity: Quantity billed.

    • Cost: Cost per item or line amount.

    • TypeDetails: Additional type-specific details, such as inspection metadata.

Example Payload Summary
This example creates an invoice for department FD28049971 for fiscal year 2026, billed to Eric's Discs, with one permit-related line item for 2 units at 100.00.

Success / Error Notes

  • Success responses typically confirm the invoice was created or accepted for processing.

  • Error responses may occur for missing required fields, invalid authentication, or malformed request data.

item.description: Provides a set of API endpoints to support posting Inspection and Incident Billing to Fire Recovery USA. Main workflow is submitting an Incident or Inspection for billing and receivng the Tracking Id on success. With the Tracking Id, you use it to submit additional attachments for each.
